retrievalProfile.description: A group portrait framed within a decorative architectural arch featuring layered, arched typography and ornate scrollwork borders.
triggerTerms: band portrait in a brick archway
vintage album cover with arched text

recipe.visualDefinition: A central group of people posed behind a railing, framed by a white brick archway. The top of the arch is filled with a decorative, scroll-edged sign containing multiple lines of text that follow the curve of the arch.
coreVisualRelationships: Text follows the curvature of the architectural arch
Group is positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame
Ornate scrollwork defines the boundary between text and image
coreInvariants: White brick archway as the primary framing device
Group portrait with subjects looking directly at the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of seven men in the lower foreground, scaled to fill the width of the archway.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched decorative sign at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large arched text, move down the scrollwork, and settle on the group portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subjects and the graphic header.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and light blue (clothing and architecture)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark brown (shadows and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, vintage saturation with high-key lighting on the subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma digital colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and condensed sans-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Primary text follows a precise radial arc
Secondary text uses a tighter arc or straight horizontal baseline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stretching to fit the arc height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for the main title paired with a condensed sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky slab-serif aesthetic of the main title
Matches the condensed sans-serif secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a group of men in 1960s casual attire (button-downs, plaid trousers) standing behind a metal railing, framed by a white brick archway. Leave the top interior of the arch empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a decorative ochre scrollwork border inside the top of the arch. Add three layers of text: the top layer in a heavy blue slab-serif following the arch, the middle in red condensed sans-serif, and the bottom in black condensed sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Text follows the curve of the arch
Brick texture is visible on the framing arch

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Specific typeface for the arched text
mustRedesign: Original band names and album titles
Exact facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Is the text legibly arched without letter distortion?
Does the scrollwork feel integrated into the archway?
Is the color palette consistent with 1960s offset printing?
Is the group portrait centered within the lower arch?
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [Subject Group] and place them inside a [Framing Architectural Element]. Add a [Decorative Border] at the top containing [Arched Display Typography] in a [Slab-Serif Style].
